concept.zh: 双分仓 · 锁住旧通道

brief.zh: 在 18 回合内和三台会换目标的对手争抢电池。第 5、10 回合结束后，分仓通道切换。被机器人或电池占住的门当次保持开启。电池抢完或回合用尽时，必须独占第一。多人同回合拾取同一块电池时，优先权按记分板顺序轮换，第 1 回合从芽芽开始。从容模式下，同一份程序须通过 2 张地图。
brief.en: Race three rivals that change targets over 18 turns. The depot gates switch after turns 5 and 10. A gate stays open for that shift if occupied by a robot or battery. Finish first outright when the batteries run out or the turn limit is reached. For simultaneous pickups of the same battery, priority rotates in scoreboard order starting with Sprout on turn 1. In Relaxed mode, one program must win on all 2 maps.
